text: The Patriots head to Chicago for Thursday Night Football against the Bears in a matchup featuring two young quarterbacks—Drake Maye and Caleb Williams—who share history from their draft class and football camps, though New England will be severely depleted on the roster this week. The team has ruled out five players for the short-week trip: cornerbacks Carlton Davis III (neck) and Channing Canada (hamstring), guards Alijah Vera-Tucker (hamstring) and Ben Brown (knee), and cornerback Karon Prunty (hamstring), while also placing wide receiver Romeo Doubs on injured reserve after he suffered a shoulder injury diving for a 42-yard touchdown reception against the Jets. Adding to the receiving corps headaches, A.J. Brown, returning from a four-week absence due to a right high ankle sprain, had an uneven Sunday performance with a career-high three dropped passes in the team's win over New York. Despite the injuries and short preparation time, the Patriots will need their remaining stars to perform in what shapes up as a challenging divisional trip against an improving Chicago team.
